title: [E16-11] Reproducible TypeScript Monorepo and Database Foundation
body:
<!-- nasj-backlog:E16-11 -->

**Parent epic:** https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/17

**User Story:**
As an engineer, I want a reproducible Next.js/NestJS/PostgreSQL monorepo, so all contributors can start the system consistently.

**Epic:** E16 — Architecture, security, tests, deployment & operations  
**Domain:** Infrastructure / Security / QA  
**Type:** Infrastructure  
**Priority:** P0  
**Target Release:** A — Phase 1 validation — 5 November 2026  
**Estimated Hours:** TBD — team estimate required  
**Story Points:** 5 — provisional source estimate  
**Sprint / Day:** Unscheduled  
**Assignee:** Unassigned  
**Owner Role:** Engineering/QA  
**Status:** Proposed  
**Source PDF Mapping:** US-046  
**Suggested Labels:** `story`, `P0`, `release:A`, `epic:E16`, `infrastructure`, `security`, `qa`

**Dependencies:** None at story level.
**Dependency Provenance:** Source blockers: —; additional proposed blockers: None.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [x] pnpm workspace, TypeScript, Prisma migrations, env example, seed, lint, typecheck, tests and one-command local setup succeed in clean checkout.
- [x] Scaffold pnpm Next.js/NestJS workspace with shared domain/contracts packages.
- [x] Define PostgreSQL/Prisma schema, versioned migrations and isolated synthetic seed.
- [x] Provide env example, startup, lint, typecheck and test commands without secrets.
- [x] Verify clean installation, migration and startup with documented pinned runtime assumptions.

**Technical Notes / Deliverables:**

Establish application, AI-support and firmware boundaries without premature microservices; include actual lockfile and generated-client workflow.

**Verification / Evidence:**

Start from a clean checkout/database, run documented commands and inspect seeded roles and health checks.

**Completion Rule:** Attach evidence for all criteria and complete review. Verify applicable permissions, failure states and business invariants. Label synthetic results; individual wearable data never enters commerce.

**Release Boundary:** Use isolated synthetic commercial records and distinguish simulation, observed evidence and physical hardware. This story does not authorize real contracts or live money movement.
